$comment: The contract for the regions in depth (codex39) and the atlas in depth (22 October 2026, BRIEF-DEEP.md; every new name, slug, key and technique is fixed in roster.cjs). Fragments live at .scripts/regions/fragments/: <sheet>.json or <sheet>.<n>.json (a sheet's mapped articles and its country), <sheet>.more.json or <sheet>.more.<n>.json (the roster's articles off the map), mapless.json or mapless.<n>.json (the map-less countries) and techniques.<n>.json (the technique companion). build-regions.cjs merges them into js/data-regions.js (the index) and js/regions/<part>.json (the reading); check-fragment.cjs proves one fragment, check-regions.js the built files. Every string is British, dash free (no U+2014, no U+2013, no entity, no spaced double hyphen), carries nothing at or above U+2190, and never the retired word for study (use rehearse, drill, study). A source url and a video url and id are no prose: the spelling rules skip them and check-fragment holds them to urlProblems (https only, no whitespace, at most 500 characters, and still no dash and nothing at or above U+2190). An empty field is a true answer: write nothing you are not sure of.

fragment.sheet: the atlas sheet id (france, italy, spain, portugal, germany, austria, california, oregon, washington, new-york, argentina, chile, australia, new-zealand, south-africa, hungary, greece); a mapless or techniques fragment has no sheet
fragment.part: a part of a sheet only: { indices: [positions in the sheet], country: true on the part that carries the country, slugs: [optional, the whole sheet's slugs] }
fragment.country: a sheet fragment's country record (below); never on a .more or techniques fragment
fragment.countries: a mapless fragment's list of country records
fragment.regions: a sheet fragment: one region record per ATLAS_V2.sheets[sheet].regions entry (or per part index), in map order; a .more fragment: the roster's articles off the map for that sheet, all or some, in roster order
fragment.more: true on a <sheet>.more[.<n>].json fragment, else omitted
fragment.techniques: a techniques fragment's list of technique records (below); such a fragment holds nothing else
fragment.aliases: an object: folded alias (lower case, accents stripped, punctuation out) to a slug or a country key, for every sub-region, appellation, village or district a house wine's region string or a question might name (medoc, pauillac, cote de nuits, chablis, langhe, rioja alta, ...). A name that is itself an article's name needs no alias. An alias to an article never names a country or a United States sheet (california, oregon, washington, new york) as whole words, since a bare country or state string would resolve to it.
fragment.terroirRows: an object: the exact TERROIR row name (its r field) to a slug, for every TERROIR row of this country
fragment.cats: an object: a Village PRIMERS cat or a Regionale INTRO_PRIMERS id that names a place in this country, to the list of slugs it covers

region.slug: unique across the whole build, /^[a-z0-9-]+$/, the region's folded name; never a country key or a technique slug; an article off the map takes the roster's slug
region.name: exactly ATLAS_V2's region name for this index, or the roster's name for an article off the map
region.sheet: the sheet id (an article off the map keeps its country's sheet)
region.index: the region's position in ATLAS_V2.sheets[sheet].regions, from 0; none for an article off the map
region.mapless: 1 on an article off the map (a .more fragment's), else omitted
region.asked: the levels whose exam asks about this region: a non-empty subset of ["intro","certified","advanced","master"], in that order (the build closes it upwards)
region.summary: 60 to 120 words: what a server must hold in the head, in four to six sentences, readable by a Certified candidate

terroir.water: 0 to 160 words: rivers, lakes, seas and their effect, or empty

grapes.name: a grape name as GRAPES, GRAPES_PLUS or INTRO_GRAPES spell it, else plain: 1
grapes.plain: 1 only when the name is in no grape list
grapes.styles: one or two sentences on what it makes here

wines.style: the wine as the list names it (Chablis, Barolo, Brut NV)
wines.colour: white | red | rose | sparkling | sweet | fortified | orange
wines.note: one to three sentences: what it tastes like, how it is served, what it goes with

made.viticulture: 60 to 300 words: training, density, harvest, the hazards, the choices that mark the region
made.winemaking: 60 to 300 words: the techniques that mark the region (method, vessel, lees, oak, blending, ageing rules, sweetening, fortification)

law.classification: 40 to 260 words: the system in prose
tiers: what it means, with the rule that matters on an exam

places.name: a sub-region, village, district or cru
places.note: one to four sentences (at least eight words)
places.depth: optional: advanced | master when the exam asks it only from that level; the place and everything nested under it then count as deeper reading
places.places: optional nested places of the same shape

producers.id: a WINE_PRODUCERS id when the Codex holds the house (p-...), else omitted
producers.name: the house's name
producers.why: one sentence: why a sommelier knows it

exam: 3 to 10 lines: what the exam asks about this region, as a study prescription
traps: 3 to 10 lines: the confusions and the false friends
say: its respelling in the house style: mar-SHAHN duh VAN, burr BLAHN, caps on the stressed syllable
region.cards: 6 to 14, each { f: a front, one ask, b: its back, at most 40 words, depth?: advanced | master }; a deepened record at least 8, at least 2 tagged and at least 6 untagged. Cards are appended only: their ids are positional
region.questions: 6 to 12, at least 3 multiple choice. MC: {cat, q, opts: [4 strings], a: index, exp, depth?, id?}. SA: {cat, q, sa: 1, accept: [2 to 8 strings the grader accepts, the canonical answer first, accents both ways], ans: 'the canonical answer', exp, depth?, id?}. cat is the region's name; id is pinned (r- and eight base36) or left out for the builder to mint. A deepened record at least 8, at least 2 tagged advanced or master and at least 5 untagged. One fact per stem; no NOT, EXCEPT or all of the above; distractors of one kind and each a real thing; exp 10 to 60 words, never naming an option by position
region.sources: at least 1 (a deepened record at least 2): [{ title: 'the work and its publisher, never an author', url?: 'https only', asOf: 'YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY', primary?: 1 for the law, the regulator or the appellation body }]
region.deeper: the deeper reading (its presence makes the record DEEPENED): 3 to 14 of { sec: land | grapes | made | law | places | producers | exam, depth: advanced | master, head?: at most 8 words, text: 30 to 220 words, src: [indices of the record's sources, from 0] }, over at least three secs, at least one advanced and one master; a text holding a digit cites two sources, or one marked primary: 1
region.techniques: 0 to 8 roster technique slugs, no duplicate; a deepened record carries at least its roster MUST_LINK
region.videos: 0 to 2 video records (below), written only by apply-videos.cjs from the evidence
region.watchSearch: 3 to 8 words: the YouTube search the fallback link builds, written only by apply-videos.cjs

country.key: the sheet id, or for a mapless country its key: the first edition's canada, england, switzerland, eastern-europe, lebanon, uruguay, mexico, and the roster's israel, georgia, turkey, cyprus, japan, china, brazil
country.name: the country's name as a reader says it (a new map-less country: the roster's name)
country.sheet: the sheet id, or omitted for a mapless country
country.mapless: 1 for a country with no map sheet, else omitted
country.overview: 200 to 700 words in paragraphs separated by a blank line: the country's wine story, its geography, the shape of its law, what the exam leans on
country.regionsOrder: for a sheet: every region slug of the sheet in map order, then the roster's articles off the map the build holds, in roster order (apply-roster.cjs sets it); for a mapless country: empty
country.places: mapless countries only: the regions, as region-shaped place entries [{name, note, depth?, places?}]
country.cards: as a region's: 6 to 14, a deepened record at least 8 (2 tagged, 6 untagged)
country.questions: as a region's: 6 to 12, a deepened record at least 8 (2 tagged, 5 untagged); cat is the country's name
country.deeper: as a region's, with sec one of overview | grapes | law | places | exam; required on the roster's seven new map-less countries
country.techniques: 0 to 10 roster technique slugs; a deepened record carries at least its roster MUST_LINK

technique.slug: a roster TECHNIQUES slug, exactly; never a region slug or a country key
technique.name: the roster's name, exactly
technique.group: the roster's group, exactly (sparkling, sweet, fortified, contact, winery, vineyard, terroir, ageing)
technique.cats: PRIMERS cats or INTRO_PRIMERS ids it belongs to, may be empty
technique.how: 80 to 300 words: how it is done
technique.why: 40 to 200 words: what it gives the wine
technique.law: 0 to 200 words (a string, may be empty): where the law requires, names or forbids it
technique.where: 2 to 10 [place, note] pairs: where it is used, by region name
technique.deeper: required: as a region's, with sec one of how | why | law | where | exam
technique.cards: 8 to 12, at least 2 tagged advanced or master; their ids are the app's (t:<slug>/<n>), never stored
technique.questions: 6 to 10, cat equal to the technique's name, at least 3 multiple choice, at least 2 tagged; ids minted over ['technique:' + slug, stem]
technique.related: 0 to 6 roster technique slugs, never itself
technique.usedBy: never written: the build computes it, the sorted slugs and keys of every article and country whose techniques list names it
technique.prose: summary, how, why, law, the steps' details, the where notes and the deeper texts at most 2,600 words

video.label: 3 to 12 words, our own, nobody named
video.channel: only when channelKind is company, named exactly as companies.json names it
video.channelKind: company (a channel of companies.json some result showed) | person (a recognised educator; ships with no channel) | unknown (no result showed a channel; ships with no channel)
video.watchFor: 8 to 30 words: what to watch for
video.verifiedBy: websearch (two different searches returned the same id and the identical title, and every channel a result showed was the same) | pack (a video of the house pack)

floors.region.prose.total: a record not deepened: 800 to 1,800 words over summary, terroir, made, law.classification, wines notes and every places note
floors.region.prose.certified: deepened: 800 to 1,800 words over summary, terroir, wines notes, made, law.classification and the untagged places notes
floors.region.prose.deeper: deepened: 300 to 2,000 words over the deeper texts and the depth-tagged places notes
floors.region.prose.whole: deepened: at most 3,600 words, Certified and deeper together
floors.country.prose.total: a record not deepened: 400 to 1,400 words over summary, overview and every places note
floors.country.prose.certified: deepened: 400 to 1,400 words over summary, overview and the untagged places notes
floors.country.prose.deeper: deepened: 150 to 1,400 words over the deeper texts and the depth-tagged places notes
floors.file: js/data-regions.js (the index, precached) under 2,000,000 bytes and each js/regions/<part>.json (the reading, fetched on first open) under 650,000 bytes, raised on 22 October 2026 from 1,100,000 and 400,000 and reset to the measured size plus 10 per cent once the deepened build is in
